settings.heading: Help more families leave home without worrying about it.
settings.lede: Mitipi is a small Swiss team building Kevin, the presence simulator that prevents burglary without cameras. If you build hardware, apps, sound or stories, we would like to hear from you.
settings.cta_subheading: Tell us what you build and why Kevin matters to you.

settings.heading: Safety without surveillance.
settings.body: We think prevention beats reaction, and privacy is not the price of security. That shapes what we build and how we work.

settings.title: Growth
settings.body: We are a small company with customers across Europe. Everyone here sees their work reach real homes quickly.

settings.title: Security
settings.body: We bring reassurance to households: prevention first, privacy always. No camera, no microphone, no data trade.

settings.title: Ideas
settings.body: Moving shadows, household sounds and a device that survives a jammed network came from thinking past the obvious. We keep doing that.

settings.heading: Small team, one product, real homes.
settings.body: Under CEO Patrick Cotting, the Mitipi team works on Kevin from Fribourg, Switzerland, with partners in Europe and beyond.

settings.image_alt: Kevin protecting a home while the family is away
settings.title: What we work on
settings.body: Hardware, the iOS and Android app, sound scenes, brand and storytelling, and expansion across Europe. If you have built any of these and want your work to make someone feel safe, write to us.

settings.title: Open roles
settings.body: There are no public listings at the moment. Send a CV and a few lines on what you would build for Kevin, and we will reply.
